title: This install's identity (user://device.json)
description: Made at first launch. Never uploaded as a file; dev is sent with every event and snapshot. fp is a hash of the hardware id: when it does not match, the file was copied from another device (backup restore, copied folder) and a new dev is made. Tokens from pairing will live in a separate file, also never backed up.

boot.description: Launch count, raised once per launch.

copied_from.description: The dev in a copied file that was replaced.
